decision: Suspend expansion of a gross first-time retail-entry crowding hypothesis. The fixed two monthly inputs are unavailable within this search, while annual originals define net eligible-population changes and differing populations. This does not prove negativeEV or universal absence of public data.

source_findings.new_investors_definition: current eligible end population minus previous eligible end population
source_findings.2017_population: Uncancelled,nondormant A-share,B-share,credit or derivative-contract accounts under UAP identities
source_findings.2023_and_2024_population: Uncancelled,nondormant A-share or B-share accounts under UAP identities

resumption_requirement: New original monthly reports with observable release dates and population-change evidence. Any use of net participation instead of first-time entry needs an explicit independent hypothesis and fixed validation contract; no backdating annual totals or rescuing the consumed household experiment.
next: Do not repeat this bounded search without new evidence. Continue a distinct, source-attainable economic mechanism under the standingCNY10000goal.
